fig1_point_source.svg: Response to a unit point source at $\xi=\tfrac12$ for $-u''$ on $[0,1]$: the closed-form tent $G=x_<(1-x_>)$ (green_dirichlet, dark) has a unit slope-jump at the source. The eigenfunction series $\sum_n\phi_n(x)\phi_n(\xi)/\lambda_n$ with $\phi_n=\sqrt2\sin n\pi x,\ \lambda_n=(n\pi)^2$ (green_series) converges to it as more modes are added — $G$ is $L^{-1}$ in the eigenbasis.
fig2_built_up_solution.svg: Superposing point-source responses solves the BVP: $u(x)=\int_0^1 G(x,\xi)f(\xi)\,d\xi$ (solve_bvp_greens, open markers) for $f=\sin\pi x$ and $f=1$ lands exactly on the analytic solutions $\sin(\pi x)/\pi^2$ and $x(1-x)/2$ (solid), and agrees with an independent finite-difference solve (solve_bvp_direct, crosses).
